s1.syndrome_frame: A firm, enlarged nasal ala with a recurrent lesion in the nasal vestibule mucosa
salient_findings: Recurrent lesion in the nasal vestibule mucosa
Tumor within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
key_facts: The patient is a woman in her 50s
The patient is a never-smoker
The lesion was first noticed 5 years prior to presentation
The initial biopsy reported a solid and cystic hidradenoma
The lesion recurred 8 months prior to presentation
The lesion was excised but recurred quickly after 2 months
Pathology showed p63 positive and p16 negative results
Imaging showed a thicker right ala compared to the left ala
Tumor was found in the ala and its extension into the floor of the nasal vestibule
